messages:
ana: Heads-up: last night's enrichment run doubled our ingest for a subset of tenants and caused a backlog. Need concrete guardrails before the next backfill.
chao: saw it too. root cause looks like mix of late-join attributes + our enrichment tool reapplying to already-enriched envelopes. dedupe only downstream so delta propagated.
vik: simple approach: require idempotency from enrichment. if root key exists (billing_key/customer_id), enrichment must not overwrite. log and skip.
ana: tiny nit: devices sometimes set billing_key later, so enrichment must be able to annotate missing fields without clobbering existing ones.
terry: propose a preflight checklist (must pass all):
  - sample-run dup estimate (>7 days)
  - run enrichment dry-run against staging with --no-commit
  - verify run_id header coverage >= 92%
  - verify avg envelope size delta < 40kb and max < 256kb
  - plan tenant cohorts + rollback window
chao: sample dup SQL (postgres):
```
WITH keys AS (
  SELECT trace_id, coalesce(billing_key, 'NULL') as bk, count(*) as cnt
  FROM staging_envelopes
  WHERE created_at > now() - interval '7 days'
  GROUP BY trace_id, bk
)
SELECT sum(case when cnt>1 then 1 else 0 end)::float / count(*) as dup_rate FROM keys;
```
vik: also emit metric enrich.backfill.estimated_dup_rate and enrich.backfill.size_delta_percentile. Gate rollout if dup_rate > 0.05 or p99 size delta > 256kb.
ana: we should add an ingest header X-Enrich-Run-Id that backfills set. Gateway should surface that and provide a short-circuit: if envelope already has run_id >= candidate_run_id, skip enrichment. ops-bot: patch ticket #INFR-1976 created for header support.
chao: for SDKs that can't set header, fall back to fingerprint (trace_id, billing_key, enrich_version). Avoid relying only on header.
vik: ownership doc snippet: billing_key -> billing-team (single writer), customer_env -> product-instrumentation, runtime_env -> infra. any overrides must be explicit PR to owners.
ana: rollout strategy: staged backfill per-tenant cohort sizes: 0.5%, 5%, 25%, 100% with 30m observation windows. auto-stop if ingest rate exceeds baseline * 1.8 or consumer lag > 10m.
vik: add a boolean dry-run flag to backfill tool that writes metrics but doesn't push to ingest. also add --mark-run-id so we can replay safely.
chao: will add the dry-run + run-id to the backfill CLI today. I'll also instrument enrich.run_id.coverage and enrich.backfill.triggered_by.
ana: I'll draft the runbook checklist + announcement template for owners and SRE. please review in PR.
ops-bot: enrichment-schema-v2 rollout: canary 25% (staging/live), no schema errors, perf delta +1.2% on p95.
ana: thanks all — let's sync 15m tomorrow to sign off on checklist. :calendar:
